feature: Mobile Inspector per-property reset meets the 44px touch-target contract

finding.reproduction: A real Chromium test at a 390px viewport measured the .property-reset button at 24.796875px high, below the 44px mobile touch target already required by the Inspector plan.
finding.impact: Resetting an individual responsive property was harder to activate reliably on a touch device than the other mobile Inspector controls.
finding.fix: The existing max-width:850px Inspector touch-target rule now gives .property-reset a 44px minimum height, 11px text, and more usable padding. The editor-refresh stylesheet URL version was bumped to bypass cached CSS.
finding.reuse_review: The project-owned responsive stylesheet, reset button, and real-browser test suite were reused. No external code, dependency, or infrastructure was needed.
